_about: Hand-checked warm space fixes (Bot 3 review 28 Oct 2026, Dean's rules 27 Oct: change only what is clearly wrong, remove nothing, label doubtful ones 'call before you go'). Only fixes confirmed on the venue's OWN website are in 'items' (own_site_url = the page that confirmed it). Re-applied by scripts/ws_locked.py as the LAST step of every warm spaces refresh, so the feed cannot undo them. Fixes that could not be confirmed on the venue's own site go in 'held': nothing is changed for them, they only appear on Dean's review list. Phone numbers are never set here (see PHONES-FOR-DEAN.md). Every entry is listed on Dean's review list (reports/layers_review.md). Undo: delete the entry; the next refresh restores the feed values.
